name: Sacrifice Yourself
overview: Scripture calls believers to a radical commitment that involves denying oneself, taking up the cross, and following Christ daily, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 16:24, Mark 8:34-35, and Luke 9:23. This self-sacrifice is not merely physical but spiritual, as believers are urged to yield themselves as instruments of righteousness to God (Romans 6:13). The ultimate expression of this sacrificial love is found in laying down one’s life for others, reflecting the love Christ demonstrated (John 15:13). Thus, true life is found in surrendering personal desires for the sake of Christ and the gospel.
